name: SDN Data Retrieval
description: Engine-native FlatSQL retrieval module: bulk per-epoch OMM stream retrieval (storage.flatsql_epoch_stream) and generic FlatSQL query streaming (storage.flatsql_query_stream). Streams pass through verbatim as ALIGNED size-prefixed FlatBuffer frames.

externalInterfaces.description: Host FlatSQL engine-native retrieval ops (storage.flatsql_epoch_stream, storage.flatsql_query_stream, storage.flatsql_cache_key).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Optional SDS CAQ envelope. CAQRequest.QUERY carries a host-specific JSON override object {schema,source,profile,epoch,limit}; CAQRequest.MAX_COUNT (when > 0) overrides the row limit.

inputPorts.description: Optional per-call overrides. Resolution order: request frame > module config (plugin.getConfig profiles) > compiled fallback (profile=nearest, epoch=now, limit=50000).

acceptedTypeSets.description: ALIGNED size-prefixed $OMM FlatBuffer stream passed through verbatim from storage.flatsql_epoch_stream.

outputPorts.description: Verbatim aligned size-prefixed OMM FlatBuffer stream.

methods.description: Resolves a per-standard epoch query profile (request frame > config > defaults) and streams the matching OMM records from the host FlatSQL engine.

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS CAQ envelope. CAQRequest.QUERY carries either a plain SQL string or a JSON object {"sql":"...","params":[{"t":"i64|f64|str|bool|null|bytes","v":...}]}.

ALIGNED size-prefixed FlatBuffer stream (schema depends on the query) passed through verbatim from storage.flatsql_query_stream. SDK manifest rules cannot express a generic aligned-binary type, so the port declares the generic flatbuffer ref; runtime frames carry the aligned-binary wire format in their TAB descriptors.

outputPorts.description: Verbatim aligned size-prefixed FlatBuffer result stream.

methods.description: Executes a FlatSQL query through the host storage.flatsql_query_stream op and streams the raw aligned FlatBuffer result.
